title: One-sentence Brick Studio
config_title: The brick studio is not connected to AI yet
config_description: Ask the deployment administrator to configure CHIMII_LLM_API_KEY or CHIMII_LLM_BASE_URL. CHIMII never pretends a rule-based parser is AI.
creation_fetch_title: Your plan is ready—we're fetching it again
creation_fetch_description: Your creation is safely saved. It does not need to be generated again.
queued: Your idea has entered the brick workshop…
checking_hint: This is not a pretend brick picture. Every piece must come from the supported catalog and, when set, your Brick Box.
failed_title: The bricks got stuck this time
failed_description: Your idea is still here. Try saying it another way, or ask a parent to check the workshop connection later.
failed_inventory: Your inventory cannot supply the required parts, specified colors or quantities. Add inventory or edit those requirements.
failed_count: The current module combination cannot match the exact part count. Please edit the count requirement.
failed_structure: The model did not pass its connection and stability checks. Try simplifying the idea a little.
start_error: The workshop is busy right now. Your idea is still here—wait a moment and press again.
answer_error: Your answer did not reach the workshop. Please choose it again.
hero_description: Describe your idea. CHIMII composes its shapes and details with real bricks, then generates instructions after computational checks.
starter_dragon: A small dragon with static wings
idea_placeholder: For example: I want a moon explorer with giant wheels…
viewer_aria: Rotatable brick model preview; use the left and right arrow keys to rotate too
result_validation_hint: Brick Box quantities, angles, and collisions are checked before the plan is delivered.
result_download_error: The LDraw file did not download. Please try again.
result_attribution: The MPD references official LDraw part IDs. LDraw is not affiliated with or endorsed by the LEGO Group.
creations_description: Every idea becomes a brick plan that has passed build checks.
creations_error_title: The creation cabinet will not open right now
creations_error_description: Your creations are still safely saved. Please open it again.
creations_empty_title: Your first invention is still inside your head
creations_empty_description: Tell us one wonderful idea and we will turn it into bricks you can really build.
detail_error_title: This creation is unavailable right now
detail_error_description: It may still be arriving, or it may belong to another child profile.
child_dialog_description: Child mode opens Build, My Creations, and Brick Box—including changing brick counts. Returning to parent mode needs a 4-digit PIN.
child_create_error: Could not create the child profile.
parent_unlock_description: Enter the 4-digit PIN set for this child profile.
parent_pin_error: That PIN did not work. Please try again.
block_error_title: The brick box will not open right now
block_error_description: Your saved brick counts are still safe. Please try opening it again.
block_unlimited_title: Every brick is ready for you
block_unlimited_description: You have not set a brick box yet, so CHIMII can use every catalog brick and color with no quantity limit.
block_custom_title: Build only with the bricks in this box
block_custom_description: The next creation will choose only these brick shapes, colors, and quantities. Children can change the counts too.
block_reset_error: The brick box could not be reset. Please try again.
block_catalog_description: Tap a color to add that brick, then use − and + to set how many you have.
block_ready_title: Ready to save your brick box?
block_ready_description: Future worlds will be checked against these exact quantities before they are created.
block_empty_description: No bricks are selected yet. You can save an empty box, but a new world will need at least the bricks it uses.
block_saved: Brick box saved. New creations will use it.
block_save_error: The brick box changed or could not be saved. We refreshed the latest counts; please check and save again.
block_kit_description: The {{count}} most common Starter Kit parts. Select one to inspect its real 3D model.
block_search_placeholder: Search by name or LDraw ID…
block_capability_auto_description: Its connections and collisions are certified, so automatic creations can use it.
block_capability_inventory_description: You can add it to your brick box. Automatic creation will not choose it yet.
block_capability_preview_description: You can inspect the real model. It stays out of creations until its connection semantics are certified.
block_no_results_description: Try another name, category, or creation capability.
block_inventory_unavailable: This part is available for preview only. It can join creation inventory after connection and collision certification.
block_reset_confirm: Clear your real brick counts and return to unlimited mode?
block_unsaved_confirm: Your brick counts are not saved. Leave anyway?
answer_label: Or add details in your own words
cancel_error: Could not stop this build. Please try again.
session_fetch_error: Could not load the build progress. Please try again.
failed_unsupported: A requested shape or mechanism capability is not available yet. Review the explanation and adjust your idea.
failed_requirements: This combination cannot satisfy all your requirements. Please edit your idea.
cancelled: This build has stopped. Your idea is still here.
progress_error: Progress could not be saved or changed on another device. Reload the saved step and try again.
editor_hint: Regenerate instructions after adjusting the shapes. Each edit saves a new creation and keeps the original build progress. Bricks can be reused.
editor_prompt_placeholder: For example: make the clock face larger and keep everything else.
editor_describe_hint: Start from the original creation. Undo unsent adjustments on the left before describing a change.
editor_submit_error: Could not submit the change. Please retry.
editor_compile_error: This layout did not pass the build checks. Adjust its size, position or support and try again.
editor_working: Arranging real bricks and checking connections…
editor_ready: The revision passed computational checks. Your original is kept.
failed_search_limit: The search has not found a validated layout yet. Try a smaller shape or fewer details; this does not prove it cannot be built.
conversation_hint: Describe your idea. We can build a brick model or a circuit using your electronic kit. Keep talking to improve it.
conversation_send_error: Sending failed or the conversation changed. Retry the same message, or edit it after refreshing.
conversation_placeholder: What would you like to make or change?
conversation_no_ai: AI is unavailable. You can still choose a reference circuit project below.
conversation_empty_hint: The materials, assembly guide and saved progress will appear here after a project passes its checks.
domain_history_hint: This saved link or conversation includes another kind of creation. You can still read its history and open every version. Start a new creation in the matching studio to continue.
